metrics_finding.finding: The user-service experienced significant increases in CPU utilization, memory utilization, and mean latency during the failure window.

evidence_summary.summary: The user-service experienced significant increases in CPU utilization, memory utilization, and mean latency during the failure window.

report.suggested_fix: Investigate and optimize resource allocation for the user-service to prevent similar issues.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to the user-service, which experienced significant increases in CPU utilization, memory utilization, and mean latency during the failure window. Further investigation is needed to confirm this.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण को विश्वसनीयता स्तर 0.8 के साथ user-service माना जाता है, जिसने फेलिंग टाइमफ्रेम में CPU उपयोग, यादृच्छिकता, और औसत लेटेंसी में महत्वपूर्ण वृद्धि देखी। आगे शोध की आवश्यकता है ताकि यह सत्यापित किया जा सके।
